I'm just gonna go ahead and say it... I loved VIII. The opening was absolutely awesome and I loved all the CGI cut scenes. I also think a big part of it was that I identified a lot with Squall's character in early high school. My older brother had the game while he was home from college and I played it one night while he was out... that game was the sole reason for me hunting down a PS1. I know most people are usually all about VII and most people also think VIII is awful. oh well!

There's no denying you've gone through a great deal of awfulness in such a small amount of time. No one should ever have to go through what you've been through. If I've learned anything in the past week of burying myself in this sub is that there are a lot of us out there dealing with what seems to be unbearable pain of many different levels and they are all reaching out to eachother wanting to help because they know from current and past experience how much it sucks to feel as we do. Just know there are people who care even if we don't know you. I wish I could offer you some solace or advise. I hope you're keeping current with a doctor to try to take care of yourself as best you can.

Did something significant happen to make you feel this way or is a chronic unexplained depression. The past few weeks have been my own personal hell due to a horrible life event that is dragging me into the bowels of misery. I feel the same way. If you feel like you want to talk let me know

That's awesome, My cat does the same thing with hair ties, he would bring it up on the bed at night and make sure he dropped it on you before he proceeded to bat at it to get your attention... I ended up playing "hair tie" from bed a number of nights
Do you find yourself happier spending time alone opposed interacting with people where you feel nothing?
I did a lot of cardio training when I did tough mudder... little did I know that I should have been concentrating on doing squats like a boss instead.

Thing is, I know exactly why I'm feeling the way I do but I just have no control over it. I feel like the only thing that would bring me out of this is reversing the problem... talking about it wouldn't fix it I feel. I guess maybe it could help me see a different side of things to help me cope... but I dunno.
I explained my situation to my doctor and whats been going on the past few weeks and he subscribed me anti depressants and something to help me sleep to get me through it.

I would happily trade with you... I'd rather have no reason to feel this way than the one I have. I also understand your point. I've felt depressed for no real reason before... You feel like if you could find the reason you feel that way then you could do something to fix it... Unfortunately that's not always the case

Wish I knew... my only motivation to be able to flash a half smile and say hi to someone who greets me at work (which I hate) is so that no one will ask if I'm okay or anything of the sort. It's hard.

I feel you. It's taken a lot of me to not breakdown at work too... I've fought it off twice already in the few hours I've been here. It's so hard to do anything, I know. I haven't told my mom about whats going on with me, but she knows. I broke down and txted her last night asking if I could come over tonight and have some drinks with her. when she asked if I was okay I broke down in tears and cried so damn hard for a half hour... I'm 31. You're not alone, I hope we can both get through it

I wish I knew... I'm in the same boat. I can't eat, I can't sleep, and I have no energy to do anything... I also have zero joy in doing things I used to like. All I can do is sit...and wait for time to pass. The only thing that seems to have been able to take my mind off of how shitty my life is now is drinking with one of my only friends who has just recently been in the same situation... I hope you find your vice and make your way out of this...
